steps.text: Steam's webhelper (CEF) hangs with msync and esync on Wine 10 (Sikarugir): the renderer never answers and Steam kills it after 90 s. Use plain wineserver sync for the Steam bottle. Verified 2026-08-23 on M1 Pro / macOS 14.6.

First launch downloads the 64-bit client (~235 MB) and extracts it. Under WoW64 + Rosetta the 32-bit bootstrapper takes 15–25 minutes and may look frozen; let it finish. If it crashes with 'nested exception on signal stack', relaunch — it resumes.
In Steam: Settings → Interface → disable 'GPU accelerated rendering in web views'; Settings → In-Game → disable the Steam Overlay. Both are unstable under Wine.

knownIssues.cause: 32-bit bootstrapper under experimental WoW64 (seen with msync+DXMT)
knownIssues.fix: relaunch; the update resumes from package/
harmless for most games; needed only for some anti-cheat/driver installs
